class.name: harambe_policy_legs_controller/HarambePolicyLegsController
class.description: ONNX RL walking policy controller for the 12 leg joints. Builds a 52-dim observation from joint states, pelvis IMU (gyro + projected gravity), base velocity (/odometry/filtered), cmd_vel and an internal gait clock; runs inference at 50 Hz and outputs POSITION targets. Claims {joint}/position, {joint}/kp, {joint}/kd per joint and writes a position target + constant kp/kd ("mode 5"); the EtherCAT drive closes the PD loop at 1 kHz. No torque / gravity-compensation is computed host-side.
